candidates.description: A Southern gentleman gambler and gunman of about forty, Georgia-born. Rich, dark baritone, smooth on top with a rough edge underneath, soft-spoken and educated, every word controlled, quiet menace and dry wit. Voice of a man on the 1880s American frontier, recorded close and dry like a film actor's dialogue, no music, no room echo. Unpolished and lived-in, not a modern announcer or narrator, not radio-smooth, no corporate or audiobook polish.
